data.camera: medium two-shot, handshake across a fan meeting table
data.description: 【星野爱 · 握手会】握手会会场里，星野爱隔着桌面握住粉丝的手，星形瞳孔亮得像两颗真正的星星，双色裙装在会馆灯光下泛着柔光——「谢谢你今天来见我……我最喜欢你了。」
data.promptProse: Across the fan-event table, Ai gently clasps a fan's hand and meets their gaze with bright star-shaped pupils. Her white-and-pink two-tone dress and collar remain visible beside the second figure in a medium two-shot. The table separates them while hall seating continues behind. Venue lights soften her hair and dress panels, catching both touching hands and leaving a narrow contact shadow between their fingers.
data.title: 星野爱 · 握手会
